How it works

A simple journey from category to click.

PKYV turns weekly trend browsing into a simple three-step flow that feels instant, clear, and satisfying.

Step 1

Choose a category

Start with the topics users already love, from K-Drama and K-Movie to K-Pop and beauty.

Step 2

Pick a year and week

Browse by chart period and instantly see what rose to the top during that week in Korea.

Step 3

Open details and watch

Check the title, duration, views, channel, and publish date, then jump directly into the video.
